accepted_coverage.headword_counting_note: Unique headword count uses normalized lemma identity. POS is preserved as metadata but does not multiply the same lemma. The previous 868 lemma+POS-row statistic is superseded after bounded normalization audit.
accepted_coverage.sense_counting_note: Exactly one minimum attested sense per accepted normalized lemma is credited unless an additional distinct sense is separately verified. Therefore 910 (=834 minimum attested senses + 76 verified reusable phrase units) is a conservative lower bound, not an exhaustive polysemy inventory.

authoritative_quantitative_commitments.interpretation: Hard floors and design/cumulative targets are corpus planning commitments, not mastery guarantees and not identical per-lesson or per-batch quotas.

previous_gap_resolution.note: The prior bounded subset remains historical evidence. Full accepted-corpus reconciliation now supplies traceable totals for the completed 27 lessons; the earlier 868 lemma+POS-row draft statistic was corrected to 834 normalized lemma identities.
